name: calculator
description: A paper desk calculator: display, a 4x4 key pad where the listed `taps` (key labels like '2','5','×','4','=') are pressed one after another (key dips, display shows the typed expression), and a result strip that prints under the calculator when '=' lands. Params: taps (default ['2','5','×','4','=']), result (shown on display + strip after '=', e.g. '₹1,00,000'), tapStart (secs after cut, 0.3), tapGap (0.28). Tossed in on the cut at a seeded tilt.
